tha-ap440:2.3: āpīḷentaṁ adutīyaṁ → papīḷentaṁ adutiyaṁ (bj, pts); āpīḷitaṁ addhaniyaṁ (sya-all) | papīḷentaṁ → āpīḷentaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap440:3.3: khādamattamhi → katamattamhi (bj) | khādamattamhi bhesajje → katamattamhi bhesajjaṁ (sya-all) | katamattamhi → khādamattamhi (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap440:3.4: byādhi passambhi → vyādhi passamhi (bj) | passambhi → passaddhi (cck: ka.)
tha-ap440:4.2: anumodamakāsi me → anumodaniyaṁ akā (bj, sya-all) | akā → anumodamakāsi me (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap440:5.3: hotu → hohi (bj, sya-all, pts) | hohi → hotu (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap440:5.4: byādhimāgamā → vyādhi āgamā (bj, pts) | āgamā → byādhimāgamā (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap440:6.3: abbhuggamī → abbhuggami (bj, sya-all) | dhīro haṁsarājāva → vīro haṁsarājā va (pts)
tha-ap440:7.1: harītakaṁ dinnaṁ → harīṭakamadaṁ (bj, pts); harītakimadaṁ (sya-all) | harīṭakamadaṁ → harītakaṁ dinnaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
